sources.entry: buzz - Transcribes and translates audio offline on your personal computer. Powered by OpenAI's Whisper. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/chidiwilliams/buzz)

summary.one_liner: Buzz is an open-source app that transcribes and translates audio offline on your computer, powered by OpenAI's Whisper.
summary.what_it_does: The README covers installation rather than detailed features; the description from the awesome-mac listing says it transcribes and translates audio offline using OpenAI's Whisper. It is distributed as a Windows installer (from SourceForge), Linux packages (Flatpak, Snap, AppImage), and a Python package on PyPI named buzz-captions, run with python -m buzz. The README mentions optional Nvidia CUDA GPU acceleration, installable from Help -> About Buzz in version 1.4.6 or later, and says PyPI users can set up CUDA-enabled torch on Windows. A link to a development version is referenced via an FAQ that is not included here. Screenshots are referenced but not included in the text.
use_cases: private speech-to-text on a personal computer
how_to_run: sudo apt-get install libportaudio2 libcanberra-gtk-module libcanberra-gtk3-module
notable: Runs Whisper transcription and translation offline on the local machine
Available as Flatpak, Snap, AppImage, Windows installer, and PyPI package
Optional Nvidia CUDA GPU acceleration via an in-app install option
Apple silicon required for macOS builds from version 1.4.6 onward; last Intel Mac support was 1.4.5
caveats: Requires Apple silicon for macOS; Intel Macs are limited to version 1.4.5
Windows app is unsigned, so installation shows a warning that must be bypassed
PyPI install requires Python 3.12 and a separately installed ffmpeg
